verses.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
verses.pt: Naquele tempo se levantará Miguel, o grande príncipe, que se levanta a favor dos filhos do teu povo; e haverá um tempo de tribulação, qual nunca houve, desde que existiu nação até aquele tempo; mas naquele tempo livrar-se-á o teu povo, todo aquele que for achado escrito no livro.
verses.en_web: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.
verses.en_bbe: And at that time Michael will take up his place, the great angel, who is the supporter of the children of your people: and there will be a time of trouble, such as there never was from the time there was a nation even till that same time: and at that time your people will be kept safe, everyone who is recorded in the book.

verses.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.pt: E muitos dos que dormem no pó da terra ressuscitarão, uns para a vida eterna, e outros para vergonha e desprezo eterno.
verses.en_web: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.en_bbe: And a number of those who are sleeping in the dust of the earth will come out of their sleep, some to eternal life and some to eternal shame.

verses.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Os que forem sábios, pois, resplandecerão como o fulgor do firmamento; e os que converterem a muitos para a justiça, como as estrelas sempre e eternamente.
verses.en_web: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: And those who are wise will be shining like the light of the outstretched sky; and those by whom numbers have been turned to righteousness will be like the stars for ever and ever.

verses.en: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
verses.pt: Tu, porém, Daniel, cerra as palavras e sela o livro, até o fim do tempo; muitos correrão de uma parte para outra, e a ciência se multiplicará.
verses.en_web: But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”
verses.en_bbe: But as for you, O Daniel, let the words be kept secret and the book rolled up and kept shut till the time of the end: numbers will be going out of the way and troubles will be increased.

verses.en: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
verses.pt: Então eu, Daniel, olhei, e eis que estavam em pé outros dois, um de uma banda à beira do rio, e o outro da outra banda à beira do rio.
verses.en_web: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.
verses.en_bbe: Then I, Daniel, looking, saw two others, one at the edge of the river on this side and one at the edge of the river on that side.

verses.en: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
verses.pt: E perguntei ao homem vestido de linho, que estava por cima das águas do rio: Quanto tempo haverá até o fim destas maravilhas?
verses.en_web: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”
verses.en_bbe: And I said to the man clothed in linen, who was over the waters of the river, How long will it be to the end of these wonders?

verses.en: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
verses.pt: E ouvi o homem vestido de linho, que estava por cima das águas do rio, quando levantou ao céu a mão direita e a mão esquerda, e jurou por aquele que vive eternamente que isso seria para um tempo, dois tempos, e metade de um tempo. E quando tiverem acabado de despedaçar o poder do povo santo, cumprir-se-ão todas estas coisas.
verses.en_web: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things will be finished.
verses.en_bbe: Then in my hearing the man clothed in linen, who was over the river, lifting up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, took an oath by him who is living for ever that it would be a time, times, and a half; and when the power of the crusher of the holy people comes to an end, all these things will be ended.

verses.en: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
verses.pt: Eu, pois, ouvi, mas não entendi; por isso perguntei: Senhor meu, qual será o fim destas coisas?
verses.en_web: I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
verses.en_bbe: And the words came to my ears, but the sense of them was not clear to me: then I said, O my lord, what is the sense of these things?

verses.en: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.pt: Ele respondeu: Vai-te, Daniel, porque estas palavras estão cerradas e seladas até o tempo do fim.
verses.en_web: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Go on your way, Daniel: for the words are secret and shut up till the time of the end;

verses.en: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verses.pt: Muitos se purificarão, e se embranquecerão, e serão acrisolados; mas os ímpios procederão impiamente; e nenhum deles entenderá; mas os sábios entenderão.
verses.en_web: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand; but those who are wise will understand.
verses.en_bbe: Till a number are tested and make themselves clean; and the evil-doers will do evil; for not one of the evil-doers will have knowledge; but all will be made clear to those who are wise.

verses.en: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.pt: E desde o tempo em que o holocausto contínuo for tirado, e estabelecida a abominação desoladora, haverá mil duzentos e noventa dias.
verses.en_web: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
verses.en_bbe: And from the time when the regular burned offering is taken away, and an unclean thing causing fear is put up, there will be a thousand, two hundred and ninety days.

verses.en: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado é o que espera e chega aos mil trezentos e trinta e cinco dias.
verses.en_web: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
verses.en_bbe: A blessing will be on the man who goes on waiting, and comes to the thousand, three hundred and thirty-five days.

verses.en: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
verses.pt: Tu, porém, vai-te, até que chegue o fim; pois descansarás, e estarás no teu quinhão ao fim dos dias.
verses.en_web: “But go you your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
verses.en_bbe: But you, go on your way and take your rest: for you will be in your place at the end of the days.
